v75: Fix Android noexec — invoke binaries via /system/bin/linker64

Android mounts app data directory as noexec. chmod +x is useless.
All binary execution now goes through _startBinary() which:
1. Tries direct execution first
2. Falls back to /system/bin/linker64 /system/bin/linker
3. Last resort: sh -c

Affected: BusyBox, Dropbear, Python, and all shell commands.
This is why every shell/SSH/python command got 'Permission denied'.

not a session-expiry signal — but apiFetch fired triggerAuthInterceptor()
on every 401, so clearAuth() then wiped the still-valid agent session.

fix(security): weak session id generation using md5 (#321)

In app/session/base.py, the GetSessionId.from_user_id method uses MD5 hashing with a predictable timestamp (int(time.time())) to generate session IDs. MD5 is cryptographically broken and predictable timestamps make session IDs vulnerable to enumeration attacks.

lowest-priority source), not a Y/n answer. The replace-existing prompt in
idempotencyCheck ran before token resolution, so on a machine with an
existing credential `echo $TOKEN | zombiectl login` consumed the piped
token as the prompt response and aborted ("existing credential kept") —
silently failing to re-auth.

false-positive 400 "path escapes RELIB_ROOT/LOGS_ROOT". Switching to
`Path.relative_to` keeps the security guarantee but works on both platforms.

via the framework checkpoint ("message", "" — no kid scope) on
thread.ID, and stages each thread as an item per spec 12 §7.3. Match
key is "schoology:message" (no kid prefix); DataSubject is sourced from
the rule (empty per spec), Audience is [guardians].

schoology: feed processor (glovebox-zi71)

ProcessFeed fetches per-kid faculty posts via GetFeed, dedupes via the
framework checkpoint ("feed", kid.Name) on the numeric EdgeID, and
stages each as an item per spec 12 §7.2. Post.Body is run through
content.HTMLToText defensively even though the library returns
whitespace-collapsed plaintext. Posts with non-numeric EdgeID are
skipped with a warning rather than aborting the surface.
